ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Hint: Please answer the question and provide the correct option letter, e.g., A, B, C, D, at the end.
Question: The Karnaugh map shown in <image> represents a function \( F \).
A minimized form of the function \( F \) is
Choices
A. \( F = \bar{X} Y + Y Z \)
B. \( F = \bar{X} \bar{Y} + Y Z \)  
C.  \( F = \bar{X} \bar{Y} + Y \bar{Z} \)  
D.  \( F = \bar{X} \bar{Y} + \bar{Y} Z \)

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the Karnaugh map shown in the image, what is a minimized form of the function \(F\)?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a three-variable Karnaugh map. The row variable on the left is X, and the two rows are labeled 0 and 1 respectively; the columns above are labeled in Gray code order as 00, 01, 11, 10, corresponding to variables YZ. The cells that are 1 in the figure are: the three cells YZ=00, 01, 11 in the X=0 row, and one cell YZ=11 in the X=1 row. The remaining cells are 0. Reasoning: Group according to the largest adjacent groups. The first group takes the two adjacent 1s YZ=00 and 01 in the X=0 row; at this time X=0 and Y=0 remain unchanged, and Z changes, so the term \bar{X}\bar{Y} is obtained. The second group takes the two vertical 1s in the YZ=11 column; at this time Y=1 and Z=1 remain unchanged, and X changes, so the term YZ is obtained. OR the two product terms together to obtain the simplest form F=\bar{X}\bar{Y}+YZ.
